get.summary: Gets the field values of an initiative.
get.description: Returns a paginated list of the field values recorded against an initiative that the caller has permission to view. Requires `view` permission at the `initiative` scope on the initiative or on its changemaker, plus `view` permission at the `initiativeFieldValue` scope for each field value returned.

parameters.name: initiativeId
parameters.description: The PDC-generated ID of an initiative.

200.description: All field values for the initiative that the caller has permission to view.

404.description: The initiative could not be found, or the caller may not view it.

post.summary: Creates a new field value for an initiative.
post.description: Creates a new value for a base field on the given initiative. Any base field category other than `organization` may be used, since organization data belongs to the changemaker rather than to one of its initiatives. Multiple values can exist for the same initiative and field combination. Requires `create` permission at the `initiativeFieldValue` scope on the initiative or on its changemaker, and `reference` permission at the `source` scope on the cited source.

parameters.name: initiativeId
parameters.description: The PDC-generated ID of an initiative.

201.description: The new initiative field value that was created.

403.description: The caller may not create field values for the initiative, or may not reference the specified source.

404.description: The initiative, base field, or source could not be found, or the caller may not view it.

422.description: The base field is an organization-category field, or the base field is forbidden.
